theme: Florida to Maine — a travel day north.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. A calm start, then you're northbound this afternoon; with the girls at Jen's, the week ahead is yours to shape.

needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is still unbooked and well past its date. Book it refundable now while there's inventory — holiday full-size rentals at PWM sell out.

needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13–Jan 2 trip for all four girls is past its Sept 30 decision date with an Oct 15 book-by deadline. Pick domestic or refundable-international and lock a shortlist.
